meta.title: PC bridge (ping / exec over HTTP)
meta.description: Listens on loopback, LAN or remote (Tailscale) for ping and shell-command requests. Settings -> PC bridge has a master switch, pairing memory, a custom secret path, local-data cleanup, and automatic WARP/Tailscale coexistence (WARP in DNS-only mode). Tools pc_ping and pc_exec let the agent use it (optionally not registered).
